items.source: Uses of AbstractMessagingTemplate in org.springframework.jms.core
Uses of AbstractMessagingTemplate in org.springframework.messaging.core
An implementation of JmsMessageOperations, as a wrapper on top of Spring's traditional JmsTemplate.
items.translation: `JmsMessageOperations` 接口（位于 `org.springframework.jms.core` 包中）的一个实现，作为对 Spring 传统 `JmsTemplate` 的包装器。

items.source: An extension of AbstractMessagingTemplate that adds operations for sending messages to a resolvable destination name.
items.translation: 扩展了AbstractMessagingTemplate，添加了向可解析的目的地名称发送消息的操作。

items.source: A messaging template that resolves destinations names to MessageChannel's to send and receive messages from.
items.translation: 一个消息模板，它将目的地名称解析为用于发送和接收消息的MessageChannel。

items.source: Core package of the JMS support.
Defines interfaces and implementation classes for messaging templates.
items.translation: 定义消息模板的接口和实现类。
